purpose: Correct the original source ambiguity before another reconstruction; source-image review only

variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: single image reference for reconstructing a detailed game sculpture.
Input image 1 is the design reference: the horned oracle statue. Rebuild this design as a beautifully sculpted multicolored matte plastic maquette, correcting unclear intersections rather than copying defects.
One complete standing classical female oracle, graceful Renaissance anatomy and contrapposto, head tilted slightly upward, arms extended down and outward with open relaxed hands, detailed face, both feet completely visible. Preserve the recognizable elegant draped gown, horned head and flowing hair. No pedestal.
Material/color separation: all skin surfaces including face, hands and feet pale peach plastic; hair saturated orange plastic; horns violet plastic; opaque draped gown and hanging cloth cobalt blue plastic; round shoulder clasps yellow plastic. All parts are the same gently satin matte resin/plastic, no stone texture, no veins, no cracks, no weathering. Colors form clean material regions, not lighting effects.
Make the sculpture physically coherent: a fully closed rounded skull with continuous scalp; hair rooted in the scalp, carved into a small number of substantial flowing locks clearly distinct from horns and cloth, without fine flyaway strands. Four solid horns in two symmetric pairs, two long upward-curving horns and two shorter outward-curving temple horns, each unambiguously rooted and separated from other shapes. Natural symmetric facial anatomy, clear eyelids, nose and closed lips. Each hand has five naturally proportioned fingers, relaxed and gently separated, no extreme splaying. Gown folds have real thickness and readable rounded volumes; hanging folds connect continuously to the gown. No floating fragments, no cut surfaces, no gaps in skull, no tangled ribbon shapes. Preserve fine artistic sculptural quality.
Camera: single almost frontal view, very slight three-quarter turn only, long lens or orthographic product-render appearance, complete figure centered with generous margin around every horn, finger and toe. Uniform soft neutral studio lighting, readable gentle shadows, no dramatic highlights or deep black shadows. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard, no labels or text. Output a single large portrait image, not a collage or contact sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the multicolored plastic oracle to improve for image-to-3D reconstruction. Keep this design, standing pose, feminine classical proportions, blue gown, orange hair, violet horns, peach body and yellow shoulder clasps. Make a cleaner physical sculpture product image rather than an atmospheric illustration.
Fix the source ambiguity: continuous CLOSED scalp with a visible center hair part and hair rooted over the entire crown. FOUR horns TOTAL, only two tall horns above the head plus two shorter horns curving outward beside the temples. Remove the little extra inward horns. Each horn is one smooth solid tapered volume with clear roots, no forked lobes or perforations. Group orange hair into six substantial rounded swept locks falling behind the shoulders, with broad carved grooves instead of many overlapping loops. Keep the hair's silhouette elegant but untangle it. Keep the gown's intricate classical folds, all in blue, with substantial rounded edges and no wispy ribbons. No surfaces floating without attachment.
Keep the human face sculpturally refined, anatomically natural eyelids, nose, closed lips, eyes slightly upward but face mostly toward the camera. Hands with five coherent fingers each and moderate finger separation. Both feet and all toes visible and physically plausible.
Camera very slightly above eye level, near frontal with mild three-quarter depth. Full figure from horn tips to soles, margin on all sides, no pedestal. Matte opaque colored resin, restrained diffuse shading, even soft white illumination, colors constant across each part. No translucency, no glossy reflections, no colored lights, no bloom, no glow, no ambient gradients, no cast shadows.
CRITICAL BACKGROUND: export a real hard clean transparent alpha cutout of the sculpture only. Outside the object including every gap between fingers, limbs, horns, hair and drapery must be zero-alpha transparency. No painted gradient backdrop. No colored haze or partially transparent halo around the silhouette. No text, labels, scenery, floor or checkerboard. Single portrait image only.
